/v1/usage

GET /v1/usage

Who may call: relay key (bearer).

Response schema

{
  "description": "Read against crates/mr-gateway/src/key_doors.rs `usage_body`. Query: from, to (ISO date or datetime, default the UTC calendar month), end_user (one tag), group_by=end_user (one row per tag).",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "object",
    "unit",
    "period",
    "requests",
    "inputTokens",
    "outputTokens",
    "costMu"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "object": {
      "const": "usage"
    },
    "unit": {
      "const": "mu"
    },
    "period": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "from",
        "to"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "from": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "to": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      }
    },
    "endUser": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "requests": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "inputTokens": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "outputTokens": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "costMu": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "micro-dollars, the unit of account"
    },
    "byEndUser": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "endUser",
          "requests",
          "inputTokens",
          "outputTokens",
          "costMu"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "endUser": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "requests": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "inputTokens": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "outputTokens": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "costMu": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "micro-dollars, the unit of account"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
